terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: An expedition desert buggy sand-crawler vehicle: a rugged open-cab off-road buggy with four big lugged balloon tyres, a sturdy tubular steel roll cage, a flat solar panel array on the roof, a small parabolic relay dish antenna mounted on the roof, sand-coloured dented body panels with terracotta paint, jerry cans and canvas bags strapped to the back, dust and scratches. Hand-painted stylised look of a high-end animated feature film prop: simplified bold readable shapes and warm sunlit desert colours (terracotta, ochre, bone, indigo, turquoise, brass), but with real physical material detail: weathered sandstone grain, oiled leather, woven linen, hammered brass patina, glazed ceramic; soft painterly studio render. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
